entities.title: Production
entities.summary: The rally Worker at icelander.net/games/retro/rally*, with its static game and the D1 database rally-scores.
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/rally/ and its public scores page.
entities.deployedBy: The Deploy workflow on every push to main that changes games/rally outside its .dev folders (or anything under .github/ outside .github/.dev); by hand with Run workflow; or `npm run deploy` with a Cloudflare token.
approvals: A pull request: main accepts nothing else.
A reviewer on the repository's production environment, if one is set.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded. The Deploy workflow deploys only from main, so going back means merging a revert, which deploys it. A database migration is not undone by this; migrations are written so the previous code keeps working (docs/database-migrations.md).
entities.details: The Worker's route runs ahead of the games hub's less specific icelander.net/games/*. Its migrations delete the Durable Object class Room, which held online rooms before they moved to the games hub; both migration entries stay, because Cloudflare applies them in order.
